title: Insurance policies and their cash value
definition: The policies held by a customer together with their current cash or surrender value. They are requested where a customer has said that wealth is held in a policy, and they establish the value of that holding as an independent party values it, rather than as the customer describes it.
evidence_to_cite: the policies, with the insurer and the policy number
the current cash or surrender value, and its valuation date
any loans taken against the policy

sources.citation: Source-of-wealth evidence, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
